# Normalization: schemas-tail-sentinel

**ID**: `schemas-tail-sentinel`
**Files**: `schemas.ts`
**Kind**: cosmetic
**Registered**: Story 1.4

## What differs

The legacy generator appends a trailing sentinel comment at the end of `schemas.ts`:

```typescript
// DO NOT EDIT — generated by tools/schema-gen/main.zig
```

The new generator does not emit this sentinel (the provenance header at the top
already carries the "do not edit" message per NFR9).

## Why it is semantically equivalent

Both convey "do not edit". The legacy sentinel is a redundant footer; the new
provenance header is the canonical form per NFR9.

## Disposition

Cosmetic. Strip the trailing sentinel from legacy output before comparison.
Removed entirely in Story 1.5 (cutover).
